risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unverified headlamp with uncertain fitment (worst-case comparable: the cheapest headlamp listing).

risks.risk: Condition/working status unknown (bulbs, reflector clarity, internal cracks, moisture ingress).

risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working/fully serviceable.

Send a close-up photo of any part number/label on the headlamp (and the connector area).
Send a photo of the car it was removed from (model/year visible) or the VIN/registration details.

response.reason: The photo clearly shows a headlamp assembly, but the seller’s text claims different categories (body/engine/suspension). With fitment and working condition unverified, price it at the worst-case comparable for headlamps.
